text:
matt: Heads up — planning to unpin runtime 2.14.1 in eu-west tonight during nightshift (00:30-01:30 UTC). Reason: kv-cache fix merged; want to validate a small canary first. Any pinned SDK/model combos that need to be exempted?

anna: +1. What exactly is the deploybot schedule? Auto rollback hooks?

deploybot: scheduled run created by @matt for 2025-11-04 00:40 UTC. Plan: canary (5%) -> phased (30%) -> full. Auto-rollback triggers: OOMs or latency >500ms sustained for 5m, or error rate >1%.

kevin: QA note — sdk-python 1.4.2 shows retries on longseqs. We have a pin for model-group "longseq-enc" in the pinlist. Recommend we exempt that group until we validate.

sophia: Can we have a per-customer fallback instead of full rollback? For enterprise lanes would prefer falling back to quant-v3b model variant.

matt: Yes — we'll run with --fallback-model=quant-v3b and a canary weight of 5%. deploybot will not ramp unless telemetry clear. I'll add an approval gate for @release-manager before ramp past 30%.

release-manager: I'm on-call and available to watch. Please add a short release note in #eng-releases and ping support with the partial-pin plan.

anna: Test plan: run the 1k-token perf harness (20 rps) for 10m against the canary, plus smoke tests for py/js sdks. I'll kick it off in ~30m and paste results here.

deploybot: canary deployed — 5% traffic to runtime-2.14.1-canary. Telemetry snapshot: P50 +12ms, P95 +18ms, errors 0.2% (baseline 0.15%). No OOMs so far. Proceed to staggered ramp to 30%? :thinking_face:

kevin: Holding — observed retryable kv-miss spikes for longseqs in the first 10 samples. Logs: ```ERROR kv_cache: miss for key len=4096 model=longseq-enc``` Might be harmless but I'd keep longseq-enc pinned for now.

matt: Ok hold and scope: abort the ramp. We will perform a partial rollback only for model-group "longseq-enc" back to runtime-2.13.8-pinned. deploybot will re-route sessions for that group. Tagging @release-manager for release note wording.

deploybot: Partial rollback executed: model-group longseq-enc -> runtime-2.13.8-pinned. Routing confirmed. Canary traffic remains at 5% for other model-groups.

release-manager: Added entry to release notes: "Partial rollback: longseq-enc remains pinned to runtime-2.13.8 due to kv-cache mismatch on long sequences; canary for 2.14.1 paused for that model-group. Re-evaluation ETA 24h." I'll also create a support bulletin for impacted customers.

anna: I'll run extended regression suites overnight and post a results summary in the morning. Thanks team — tagging the runbook for reference <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/unpin-check>. :thumbsup:
